All operations are confined to the build directory and target only expected files.

No network requests, dynamic downloads, obfuscated code, or dangerous commands (e.g., `eval`, `curl|bash`) are present. The modifications are transparent and limited to desktop integration. The package installs into `/opt/appimages`, a conventional location for AppImages, and does not modify system state beyond standard desktop database entries. </details>
